notes.title: Low-end PC Optimization is Done
notes.content:
Bugs fixed:

 FPS dropping
 Light leaking
 Low quality textures
 Camera Lagging


Things reworked/redesigned

 Overall lighting - Cinematic lighting
 Character movement
 Added new jumpscare
 More spooky atmosphere


New Upcoming Horror Game - Masked Menace 
Demo will be available in mid July.
